title: Vampire Vape Tropical Mango Paradise Flavour Concentrate 30ml
description: Vampire Vape Mango Paradise Flavour Concentrate captures the vibrant fruit trio from the Tropical collection in a 30ml DIY format. Designed for experienced vapers who enjoy customising their e-liquid blends, this concentrate layers juicy Mango with zesty Blood Orange and tangy Pineapple for a bold, tropical-inspired flavour. The Mango adds mellow sweetness and depth, while the Blood Orange offers a bright, citrus twist. Pineapple rounds off the mix with its tart, fruity edge—resulting in a flavour that’s both sunny and satisfying when mixed to your preferred VG/PG ratio and nicotine strength. Please note: This is a flavour concentrate and must be diluted with VG, PG and, if required, nicotine before use. Not suitable for vaping on its own.
